cleaner.label: pnpm
cleaner.description: pnpm package store and metadata cache. Does not touch projects, node_modules, configuration or credentials.

option.label: pnpm package store
option.description: Removes the global store where pnpm keeps downloaded packages.
option.warning: Re-downloaded on the next `pnpm install`; existing node_modules stay valid (they are hard links).

option.label: pnpm metadata cache
option.description: Removes the package metadata cache, the dlx cache and some install checks.
